title: Releases intake: named fields, captured saves and pending-outcome boundaries
goal: Understand the 52 named intake source callsites, their actual local conditions and captured-save behavior without mistaking entered assertions or saved versions for approval or provider success.
prerequisites: Internal source-only draft at the exact bound source, not a supported-release or customer-approved guide. Verify the installed version and actual reachable entry separately.

The proposed screen ID and all52 releases.intake.* IDs are documentation source-callsite identifiers only: not DOM attributes, query selectors, unique field-instance identities or mounted help navigation.

Use the intended current workspace/request and actual permitted New release, Complete release details or Revise path. No session, credential, role, endpoint or provider operation is granted by this article.
permissions: Owner/contact fields, PR approval, No production PR required, readiness checkboxes and confirmed-fact attribution are entered assertions, not verified people, role changes, independent review records or policy waivers.

Create/revise saves Axiom intake/version history only. Current server acceptance and downstream exact independent approval/execution checks remain authoritative; this mapping does not enumerate every server validation.
A workflow/ref/environment choice, source metadata, cited evidence ID or local validation result grants no provider permission, execution coverage, Governance enrollment or activation.
Planned manual/validation/rollback instructions and responsibility categories do not run commands, schedule follow-up, notify owners, perform backup or verify recovery.

steps.instruction: Deliberately choose Submit release request, Submit completed request or Save revision only for the intended current form and version.
steps.expectedState: The form captures its existing payload and creates or revises the Axiom request. Revision uses the displayed request ID/version; create uses the form submission identifier. Pending Release intake fields are disabled; synchronous update/submit guards reject pending edits or duplicate submissions. This records no provider change, ticket creation, deployment or independent approval.

steps.instruction: While Saving release details, leave only if intended. If the outcome is unavailable, check the intended saved requests and current version before deciding the next step; preserve unresolved outcome context and ask for help when it cannot be reconciled.
steps.expectedState: Leaving does not cancel a save already sent or prove failure. Only the still-mounted original form may run its success callback, so a late departed-form result cannot close a replacement draft. A returned refusal retains the mounted form; a thrown save retains and unlocks it with a fixed unconfirmed-outcome message. No automatic replay, durable pending-save journal, guaranteed idempotent retry or cross-session outcome adoption is established.

expectedOutcome: Inspect or correct the named local intake fields and save only the intended captured request/version, preserving unresolved outcomes without treating local completeness, a saved revision or reported approval/readiness as provider authority.
limitations: Customer eligible:false. Publication approved:false. Editorial/media/native/runtime/shipped acceptance unproven. Review identity/date remain null, media empty, source-only verification dates null. No genuine human decision or customer retrieval is claimed.

Scope is all52 Field/TextArea/SelectField/Check source callsites in DeploymentIntakeForm, not52 simultaneously visible/runtime-accepted controls. Runtime helper-family attributes and intrinsic navigation/submit controls are separate mappings.

Imported WorkflowCatalogue, WorkflowDefinitionInputs including dynamic workflowInputs fields, and ReleaseBatchSelection controls are excluded from the52 IDs. Their issues may still block submission; this article neither requalifies their internals nor invents extra source IDs.

Window start/end and Expected follow-up date are machine-local datetime inputs converted using localToIso; Display time zone is a separate recorded label, not a conversion setting. Window instants are explicitly checked at submit; no date-ordering or identical explicit check for every other date is asserted.

Manual-step fields use raw text truthiness for visibility, but validation/serialization require trimmed nonempty text. Planned serialized steps remain completed:false and evidenceRequired:true; entered instructions are not execution evidence.

Required HTML props, local nonempty-string presence checks and server acceptance are separate layers. No required prop/presence test proves URL format, chronology, owner identity, eligibility or current connection health.

The pending fieldset is a local UI freeze, not cancellation of a sent save. Mounted-form checks concern local completion ownership, not proof of tenant/session authority, global request locking or a durable recovery ledger.

Confirmed operational fact, Source evidence identifier and Confirmed by are user-supplied inputs. The serialized fact classification confirmed is not external verification, accepted evidence, identity proof or a genuine independent review.

This new canonical article changes the moving article-directory dataset. The pending exact24-record evaluation and its frozen snapshots/manifests remain untouched; no earlier evaluation approval, result or count extends to this article. Proposed cases remain unexecuted.
recovery: Correct local errors in the indicated step and review the intended scope/version. A service refusal leaves entered form state available; absence of an error never establishes provider success.
During a pending save do not assume visible Cancel intake, navigation or unmount cancels the request. A later original-form callback is ignored after departure, not a rollback of server persistence.

For an unconfirmed save read the intended saved requests/version before another submission. Missing or unavailable records do not prove failure or authorize automatic resend; retain context and escalate if unresolved.

This article supplies no durable unknown-outcome retry, cross-session adoption or provider recovery procedure. Preserve consumed/unknown provider histories and use their separately verified lifecycle guidance.

On source/version/hash mismatch quarantine this draft and request a new reviewed revision. Do not rebind old evidence, resurrect a superseded article or present local fixtures as current shipped acceptance.
